result_json.message: Document issue resolution design and explicit-issue MVP scope
docs: add explicit issue resolution implementation plan (217)
docs: add plan review for explicit issue resolution

items.title: Validate source discovery and inspect existing linked PRs
items.reason: The specified unrestricted regex marker grep can match untrusted raw snapshots rather than a brief first line, and marker-only PR search misses existing unmarked linked PRs. The linked-prs snapshot retrieval and pinned source reference for reviewers are not concretely specified.
items.failure: Duplicate implementation or incorrect source/plan association, including interpreting quoted hostile source markers as workflow identity.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Define gh queries for linked PRs plus marker/branch matches; validate literal canonical first-line brief markers and plan associations at each ref; pin original source commit/blob references for comparison and review; preserve snapshots on incomplete continuation. Add corresponding command/fixture/manual cases without a new index.

items.title: Make refresh and closure reconciliation compatible with sealed runs
items.reason: The universal refresh-file/addendum rule conflicts with post-seal immutability and the non-writing orchestrator. Treating every state change from intake as material blocks both successful second resume after this workflow closes the issue and the promised externally-closed reconciliation path.
items.failure: Normal retries become permanently blocked or source refresh writes into sealed workflow history.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Separate delegated pre-seal source revisions from read-only post-seal refresh. Reconcile marked prior closure and external closure before generic state-drift handling; detect reopening against a delivery receipt. Add repeat-resume, externally-closed, reopened, and read-only refresh cases.

items.title: Use authoritative accepted delivery endpoints and normal completion evidence
items.reason: final_head_commit and a review-document commit are not authoritative review endpoints. The runtime reviewedRange is the latest observation range, and records-only allowance rejects ordinary review/checklist commits and admitted quality-backed corrections. Endpoint-only name diff also does not prove ancestry or per-commit records-only changes.
items.failure: Unreviewed or divergent work can be attested as delivered, while valid ordinary completion and squash delivery can be rejected.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Specify exact accepted endpoint and range extraction from durable runtime contexts, observations, correction/completion evidence, and sealed records; restrict legacy extraction to unbound compatibility. Distinguish overall delivery from latest phase range, check ancestry and configured evidence-path allowances, preserve authorized final corrections, and verify mutable PR claims against committed evidence. Add executable Git/protocol fixtures where seams exist.

items.title: Separate plan and implementation finding classes in all modes
items.reason: The design labels missing criteria acceptance_required for both reviewer types, contradicting Phase 2.3 and the implementation domain. Phase 2.3 also prescribes implementation-only fields without preserving the existing mode-off/unbound v1 exception.
items.failure: Issue-acceptance findings fail validation or enter the wrong review and amendment route.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Qualify the design and initial/continued clauses: applicable plan review uses plan classes; bound implementation review uses implementation_defect linked to approved W IDs or plan_defect under source-of-correction precedence; off/unbound review retains v1 output. Preserve existing evidence requirements and add mode/domain contract assertions.

items.title: Define unauthorized publication and failed synchronization exits
items.reason: Detailed publication steps assume authorization, and reconciliation advances from publishing evidence to closing without explicit failure exits. The concrete delivered_sync_pending rule covers release conditions but not failed or unknown comment/close writes required by the input.
items.failure: Premature issue closure, false success after failed remote writes, duplicate comments on retry, or unusable publication handoff.
items.lowestCostCorrection: Specify no-authorization and failed-push/PR handoffs. Require confirmed marked evidence publication before close; failed or unknown comment/close results return delivered_sync_pending with the exact missing operation and resume steps. Re-read and reuse remote objects on retries; add denied authorization and remote-write failure cases.

result_json.summary: The asset-led MVP fits the existing architecture. Five objective plan corrections are required for reliable source discovery, sealed-run refresh, trusted delivery identity, classification compatibility, and publication recovery; no broader package infrastructure or unresolved product decision is needed.

baselineAssessment.reason: Independent assessment of bounded intake/provenance, compact and coverage prompt integration, multi-run delivery instructions, and effective multi-mode installation/override verification. Exact delivery identity and retry contracts make this cross-cutting asset work, but no new workflow engine, database, provider, or command family is necessary.
